description: Calculate and compare home equity loan or HELOC monthly payments from explicit caller-supplied amount, note rate and term assumptions. Models fully amortizing repayment, an optional interest-only HELOC draw phase, a repayment rate change and one-time cash/financed fees. Returns both phase payments, payment change and modeled interest/cost totals. No lender quote, eligibility decision, rate selection or APR calculation. Missing fees stay unknown. No personal identifiers needed.

scenarios.description: One to eight explicit payment assumptions. Ask for missing amount, note rate and term, or clearly agree on hypothetical examples.

amount_borrowed.description: USD cash borrowed or initially drawn, excluding any financed fees.

annual_interest_rate_percent.description: Caller-supplied note interest rate, not APR; 8 means 8%. Do not infer a borrower's rate.

fees.description: Optional one-time fee assumptions. Omit if unknown; omitted fees are excluded, not represented as confirmed zero.

financed.description: One-time fees added to the balance, in USD. Do not include these in amount_borrowed.

upfront_cash.description: One-time fees paid in cash, in USD. Enter 0 only if explicitly assumed or confirmed.

interest_only_months.description: HELOC only: assumed interest-only draw months, followed by full amortization. No additional draws.

label.description: Short scenario name; do not include personal identifiers.

repayment_interest_rate_percent.description: Optional rate-change scenario at the start of repayment after interest-only months. Otherwise the same rate continues.

repayment_months.description: Number of fully amortizing monthly payments AFTER any interest-only phase.

name: compare_home_equity_payments
title: Compare home equity payment scenarios
